title: A Generalized Bayesian Approach to Clustering with Dimension Reduction
abstract: arXiv:2611.09698v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generalized Bayes product partition models provide a probabilistic counterpart to loss-based clustering. They update a prior over partitions through an exponentiated clustering loss rather than a likelihood, so allocation uncertainty can be quantified without a full generative model for the data. However, their performance depends on the space in which the loss is evaluated. For high-dimensional observations, a squared Euclidean loss on the raw features can be dominated by irrelevant coordinates or fail to reflect cluster structure lying near a nonlinear low-dimensional manifold. We propose an extension in which an autoencoder and the partition are learned together, so that the space in which the clustering loss is evaluated is shaped by the clustering itself. translated_title: 一种结合降维的广义贝叶斯聚类方法
translated_abstract: 广义贝叶斯乘积划分模型为基于损失的聚类提供了概率化的对应方法。它们通过指数化的聚类损失（而非似然函数）来更新划分上的先验分布，因此无需为数据建立完整的生成模型即可量化分配的不确定性。然而，其性能取决于损失函数所评估的空间。对于高维观测数据，在原始特征上使用平方欧氏损失可能会被无关坐标主导，或者无法反映位于非线性低维流形附近的聚类结构。我们提出了一种扩展方法，将自编码器与划分联合学习，使聚类损失的评估空间由聚类本身塑造。我们的广义后验将重建损失（保持低维表示忠实于观测数据）与簇内平方和相结合……（摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出将自编码器与广义贝叶斯聚类划分联合学习，在学到的低维表示空间中评估聚类损失，从而在不依赖完整生成模型的情况下实现高维数据的概率化聚类并量化分配不确定性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a generalized Bayesian clustering method that jointly learns an autoencoder with the partition, evaluating the clustering loss in the learned low-dimensional representation to enable probabilistic clustering with uncertainty quantification for high-dimensional data.
